title: VMware security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-184.112718: TT-CSIRT Advisory – VMware Security Updates
leadParagraph: VMware has released a security update stating that VMware Workstation and Fusion contain an integer overflow vulnerability in the virtual network devices.
contentHtml:
VMware has released a security update stating that VMware Workstation and Fusion contain an integer overflow vulnerability in the virtual network devices.

This issue may allow a guest to execute code on the host.

Further information on this vulnerability and how it can be mitigated can be found on the VMware Website at https://www.vmware.com/security/advisories/VMSA-2018-0030.html
